_readme: Subtopics for each topic. Each subtopic has a list of keywords. A question or flashcard gets a subtopic when its text (question + options, or card front; then the explanation / card back if nothing matched) contains one of the keywords. Plain words match whole words (plural 's' allowed); short ALL-CAPS words like SPAN or ACL are case-sensitive; start a keyword with re: to use a regular expression. Edit this file, run python tools/build.py, then upload data/. Items that match nothing go to 'General / other'. python tools/build.py --report shows how well it matches.

Virtual Switching & Networking: route based on originating virtual port
